item.title: RemoteControl.ZMQ v1.5.5.38
item.description:
Product: RemoteControl.ZMQ v1.5.5.38
Company: LevyLab
Release Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 16:49:52 -0400
Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: Override library implementing ZMQ lazy pirate reliable request reply (RRR) protocal using RemoteControl SMO framework.

Release Notes: ### 1.5.5

A server (REP) now replies to a request that is not valid JSON instead of leaving the socket stuck (#9). The reply is a JSON-RPC 2.0 error: `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":null,"error":{"code":-32700,"message":"Parse error"}}`. A request that is valid JSON but malformed (for example, missing or with an empty `method`) gets `-32600 Invalid Request`. In both cases the server keeps answering the requests that follow, so no restart is needed. Before this, a non-JSON request got no reply, and REQ/REP lockstep kept the server from answering anything else.

item.description:
Product: JSON-RPC v1.3.0.18
Company: PRIrvin

Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: Library for encoding and decoding JSON-RPC 2.0 request and response objects

https://www.jsonrpc.org/specification

Release Notes: JSON-RPC 1.3.0
- Parse Request returns -32700 "Parse error" for non-JSON or malformed input (previously no error).
- Parse Request returns -32600 "Invalid Request" when "method" is missing or empty.
- Create Response always answers an error; an unknown id ("-1" or "") is sent as "id": null.
- Parse Response accepts "id": null and returns id "-1".
- Flatten to String / Unflatten from String now carry Base64 inside ["..."] (not compatible with 1.2.x flatten payloads). Unflatten returns -32602 for a malformed payload.

item.title: JSON-RPC v1.2.8.17
item.description:
Product: JSON-RPC v1.2.8.17
Company: PRIrvin
Release Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 21:16:33 -0400
Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: Library for encoding and decoding JSON-RPC 2.0 request and response objects

https://www.jsonrpc.org/specification

Release Notes: JSON-RPC 1.2.8

Fixed
Instrument errors are no longer sent as a bare null (PRIrvin/JSON-RPC#2). Until now, Create Response.vi produced a real error reply only for the reserved JSON-RPC codes (-32700, -32600, -32603..-32601, -32099..-32000). Any other code, such as the Instrument Framework’s 4001 “command not supported”, 5402, or DAQmx errors, went out as the literal null with no envelope. Every error code now produces a standard reply:
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","error":{"code":4001,"message":"command not supported"},"id":"1"}

The message is the LabVIEW error’s source text. Codes are sent as they are; 4001 is not remapped to -32601.

Behavior change
Clients that used to get an empty result with no error for an unsupported or failed command will now get an error. LabVIEW clients (Parse Response.vi, RemoteControl.ZMQ) return it on error out with the original code. Python clients get an error member instead of None. Check scripts that relied on the old silent result.

Tests
New UNITTEST-JSON-RPC-Error-Object.vi, added to UNITTESTS.vi. It covers non-reserved, DAQmx and reserved codes, the no-error and notification (id “-1”) cases, and a Create Response / Parse Response round trip.

Upgrading
Instrument Type and RemoteControl.ZMQ accept this version without being rebuilt.
Multichannel-Lockin: its ApplyMe_2.23.0.vipc pins JSON-RPC 1.2.6.15 exactly, so regenerate it with 1.2.8.
Instrument executables (lock-in, KH7008, Transport Server) must be rebuilt to include the fix.

Known issue
A request that isn’t valid JSON still gets no reply, which leaves the server’s ZMQ REP socket stuck until the instrument is restarted. The fix is planned mainly in RemoteControl.ZMQ. Don’t send malformed requests to running instruments.

item.title: Instrument Framework v1.15.14.56
item.description:
Product: Instrument Framework v1.15.14.56
Company: LevyLab
Release Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 14:00:57 -0400
Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: An object-oriented framework based on JKI SMOs, developed by the LevyLab at the University of Pittsburgh.

An Instrument developed using this framework will have the access to the following capabilities:

- Framework for communicating with hardware (Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL))
- Periodically polls the instrument for its settings and logs them to a PGSQL database
- Defines an API to allow external programs to control compiled instances of the application and remotely across a network (Either NI's Simple Messaging Library (STM) (deprecated in v1.9) or cross-platform protocol ZMQ (preferred beginning with v1.9))
- Provide a user interface (optional but probably desirable).
- Methods for reading and writing configuration from disk.

Release Notes: [1.15.14]
#201 Open SMO.vi tests for existing connection and preserves connection if one already exists

item.title: Transport v2.7.0.65
item.description:
Product: Transport v2.7.0.65
Company: Levylab
Release Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 18:20:12 -0400
Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: VIs for scripting and performing transport measurments.

[Control Experiment]
- Control Experiment.vi
- provides a uniform way to record information about your sample & device
- record how the lockin is connected to the device
- configure the Krohn Hite amplifier
- set the base path for saving data
- configure peripheral instruments
- APIs for recording sample data, instrument status

[Transport]
Basic transport measurments:
- Lockin vs time (Lockin_time.vi)
- Lockin Sweep Mode (Lockin_sweep.vi)

[Transport Server]
Server used for scripting and performing asynchronous transport measurments.


Release Notes: ### 2.7.0

Experiments no longer stop for an error dialog, and a lock-in that is briefly unreachable no longer ends a sweep (levylabpitt/Transport#180).

- Lockin_sweep, Lockin_time and THz_TimeDelay: errors are logged to "Transport errors.log" in the experiment folder instead of opening a dialog. Brief communication errors (timeouts) are retried; any other error stops the run cleanly, saving what was acquired.
- Lockin_sweep: keeps polling through short lock-in outages and stops with error 5162 only if the lock-in does not answer for 60 s. Sweep data is read with retries.
- Lockin_sweep files now include:
- "Sweep-Data-Valid": False if the sweep data could not be read, so the file holds no sweep arrays;
- "Time-Array": the timestamp of each data point, derived from t0 and dt of the waveforms.
- Configure Experiment: opens each instrument once and keeps the connection for the session, instead of reconnecting on every poll.
- Experiment windows have a button to open the experiment folder in Explorer.
- Transport Server: experiments are started by method (LockinSweep, LockinTime, LockinTimeDelay), and their front panels can be shown or hidden.
- Transport Server front panel controls are preserved
- Deprecated: Sweep Control and Continuous B Sweep can no longer be started from the Transport Server.

Requires RemoteControl.ZMQ 1.5.4 and labview-zmq 3.7.1 (install both on every machine that runs Transport).
item.dc:creator: Levylab

item.title: Multichannel Lockin v3.8.6.97
item.description:
Product: Multichannel Lockin v3.8.6.97
Company: LevyLab
Release Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 16:00:59 -0400
Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: Multichannel Lockin for National Instruments' Dynamic Signal Acquisition hardware (4431, 4461, 4462).
- This version is configured to handle multiple cards for simultaneous, synchronized AI/AO.
- The analog outputs can be configured to output sine, square, sawtooth, or triangle functions with (swept) DC offsets.
- Each of the analog inputs can be demodulated at multiple frequencies.

Release Notes: ### 3.8.6
Rebuilt against RemoteControl.ZMQ 1.5.4 and labview-zmq 3.7.1.
- Fixes occasional crashes ("ZeroMQ Abort" dialog, then error 1097) in the lock-in and in LabVIEW clients: labview-zmq 3.7.1 ships a libzmq built without WSAPoll (levylabpitt/RemoteControl.ZMQ#2).
- #183 getStatus replies in ~8 ms around startSweep; fixes getStatus timeouts during Transport sweeps (requires RemoteControl.ZMQ 1.5.4 and labview-zmq 3.7.1)
- #184 Improved DAQmx error classification (recoverable vs. fatal errors)
- #185 setSweepTable, and the sweep-pattern table in the UI, applied only the last table when several channels were given one; all tables are applied now. New method names setSweepTime and setSweepTable; setSweep_Time and setSweep_Table still work but are deprecated.
Machines that run Transport, FLEX or other clients need RemoteControl.ZMQ 1.5.4 and labview-zmq 3.7.1 installed too; the crash fix only applies where they are installed.
